TikTok Money Calculator — Honest Short-Form Benchmarks

TikTok's Creator Rewards pays per 1,000 qualified views — typically $0.04–$1.00, far below YouTube long-form. This page compares what short-form actually pays against long-form, so you can price your content and time honestly.

TikTok vs YouTube per 1,000 views (2026 benchmarks)

YouTube long-form$1–$17 (by niche)55% creator share of ad revenue

TikTok Creator Rewards$0.04–$1.00Per qualified view

The qualified-views trap

Not every TikTok play pays. Eligible content, For You feed delivery and watch behavior all matter — your Creator Rewards dashboard RPM is the only real number. As a planning estimate: 1,000,000 qualified views at $0.40 RPM ≈ $400; at $0.70 RPM ≈ $700.

Why creators stack income streams

TikTok's real money is often sponsorship + LIVE gifts + TikTok Shop, not the Rewards pool. Mid-tier creators earn 5–20× more from brand deals than from ad revenue alone. Model the full picture across all your income streams.

Frequently asked questions

How much does TikTok pay per 1,000 views?

TikTok does not publish one fixed rate. Creator Rewards benchmarks range $0.04–$1.00 per 1,000 qualified views depending on niche and audience country; use your dashboard RPM for your actual figure.

How much is 1 million TikTok views worth?

At a $0.40 RPM, about $400; at $0.70 RPM, about $700 — before sponsorships, gifts and Shop commissions.
